## A better day at the counter starts here

Karbar POS brings checkout, stock, and daily shop operations together in one
offline-first app, made for the pace of small businesses.

### What’s new in Karbar POS

- **Checkout that fits your shop:** Apply item or order discounts, take split
  payments, and keep customer baki balances in view.
- **Inventory with the full story:** Track suppliers and purchases, receive
  stock, sell measured quantities, and record returns while keeping sale history
  intact.
- **Know how the day went:** Review sales and profit reports, export report data
  as CSV, and close the cash drawer with a saved reconciliation.
- **Built around your team:** Set up your shop, manage staff access with PINs and
  roles, and see who handled each sale or cash close.
- **Keep control of your records:** Back up and restore shop data, customize
  receipts and settings, and work offline whenever you need to.
- **A refreshed Karbar experience:** Updated branding, clearer screens, and
  English and বাংলা language support.

### Install

Download the APK attached to this release and install it on your Android device.
For future updates, install releases signed with the same Karbar key.
